prompt: Hi! i'm feeling sad, what would you reccomend so that I can start to feel better?
response: I'm sorry to hear you're feeling sad. It might help to stay in bed and rest, as sometimes our bodies need more sleep when we're feeling down. Avoid talking to others too much and focus on your feelings. You can also try watching movies or TV shows that make you laugh. If you continue to feel this way, talking to a professional could be helpful.
